## Positron Installation on Fedora 43

- 1 [download positron](https://positron.posit.co/download.html)
- 2 `sudo rpm -i install Positron-2026.01.0-147-x64.rpm`

## Uninstall Positron

- 1 `sudo dnf remove positron`
- 2 `rm -rf ~/.positron`
- 3 delete all data in ~/.config/Positron except settings.json and keybindings.json in ~/.config/Positron/User directory.
